purpose: Preserve root-only protected release state while restoring traversal-only access to the state parent and pcactions-readable redacted evidence after every exact-main controller execution.
requiredBehavior: delegate protected release logic to an exact-main core script from the root-owned protected checkout
require the wrapper and installed controller to match the exact current main
restore /var/lib/pc-release-authority as root:pcactions mode 0710 after every controller exit
keep protected repository and controller-jobs root:root mode 0700
publish only regular redacted evidence files as root:pcactions mode 0640
preserve the original controller return code unless boundary restoration itself fails
retain the non-root runner and restricted controller-only sudo authority
forbiddenCapabilities: runner access to protected repository, controller state or model private key
